command_line:
set -eu
python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request

entry = "pa14:PA14_09540"
urls = [
    f"https://rest.kegg.jp/get/{entry}",
    f"https://www.kegg.jp/dbget-bin/www_bget?{entry}",
]
with open("kegg_pa14_entry_probe.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    for url in urls:
        out.write("URL\t" + url + "\n")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            headers={"User-Agent": "Galaxy-KEGG-entry-probe/1.0", "Accept": "text/plain"},
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
                body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                out.write("STATUS\t" + str(response.status) + "\n")
                out.write(body[:4000] + "\n")
        except Exception as exc:
            out.write("ERROR\t" + repr(exc) + "\n")
PY
